description:
Jade 26'' Cruiser Bike

Step-thru Frame - Easy for riders to straddle a bike.
Dual-Spring Seat - Fully guarantees riding comfort.

26*2.1" Wide Tire - Provides a smooth and comfortable ride.
Rear Coaster Brake & Single Speed - Easy to use and provides reliable control.

Classic and Sturdy Frame

Hiland hi-ten steel frame is lightweight and durable.

Also, the step-thru frame is very friendly to ladies and shorter riders, especially those in skirts, and allows them to straddle the bike more easily.

A wide and comfortable dual-spring seat can deal effectively with bumps on the road and fully guarantees riding comfort.

It is also equipped with a quick release seat post clamp to easily adjust the height of the saddle.

Comfortable Riding

The back handlebars provide an upright riding position for comfortable long rides, and riders can easily adjust the height and tilt of the handlebar for a customized ride.

26*2.1" tires make riding effortless and non-slip, handle pavement, gravel and beach with ease.

High profile double wall aluminum rims are light and strong, able to withstand the bumps during the ride.

Easy Handle

The single-speed drivetrain offers ultimate simplicity and is ideal for flat terrain. It is also easy to maintain.

Rear coaster brake is simple to provide dependable control as you need it - just pedal backward to glide to a stop.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled and easy to assemble within 25 minutes. The delivery box includes free installation tools and pedals.

* The front fork is reversed in package. Please reverse it before wheel installation!

Solutions will be quickly provided by support team within 24 hours! Bikes all have been inspected before package. Solve all your worries!

Single Speed Drivetrain

A simple one speed drivetrain is easy to ride. Rear coaster brake provides dependable control as you need it, just pedal back to stop.

Comfortable Seat

An ergonomic and wide dual-spring seat fully ensures a comfortable ride.

2.1" Wide Tires

26*2.1" wide tires can easily adapt to beach conditions. Dual-wall rims allow them to withstand high-intensity riding and protect the inner tube from rupture.

Low Step-thru Frame

Hiland classic style high-carbon steel frame is lower so it's easier for riders to stand over and hop on and off.

Experience effortless style with the Hiland Jade Women’s Cruiser Bike. Featuring a step-through frame, single speed, and a vintage aesthetic. Perfect for beach rides and city strolls.
